evidence.quote: This proposal outlines the minimally required interfaces and behavior for modular smart accounts and modules to ensure interoperability across implementations.

Smart accounts that have already been deployed will most likely be able to implement this standard.

notes.zh:
交集：Agent 钱包要把验证器、执行器、Hook 与恢复模块拆开组合；ERC-7579 给了一套最小接口，让不同实现能互相插模块。
适用范围：官方规范只规定账户与模块的最小接口、模块类型与安装/卸载行为；它不规定具体安全策略，也不保证每个模块经过审计。已有账户可能通过代理升级或 fallback adapter 兼容，但不是自动兼容。
未解决：模块组合后的权限冲突、升级路径、模块注册表与供应链安全，仍要由账户实现方与审计方各自处理。
notes.en:
Intersection: agent wallets need to compose validators, executors, hooks and recovery modules; ERC-7579 provides a minimal interface set so different implementations can plug modules into each other.
Scope: the official spec only defines minimal account/module interfaces, module types and install/uninstall behaviour; it does not prescribe security policy or guarantee that every module is audited. Existing accounts may become compatible via proxy upgrades or fallback adapters, but not automatically.
Open: permission conflicts after module composition, upgrade paths, module registries and supply-chain security remain the responsibility of account implementers and auditors.
